$comment: Routing config for the qa-orchestrator plugin. Precedence: these values are overridden by env vars (QA_ROUTER, QA_CHEAP_MODEL, QA_STANDARD_MODEL, QA_DEEP_MODEL, QA_ROUTER_MODEL, TYPESAFE_MODEL, TYPESAFE_ENDPOINT).
instructions: Which cost tier should handle this software/QA task

criteria.cheap: Mechanical, repetitive, small or well-specified edits, formatting, test data, renames, writing a straightforward test or spec
criteria.standard: Normal engineering work: writing or fixing tests, triaging a failure, code review, small refactors
criteria.deep: Hard architecture, subtle or ambiguous debugging, unclear design, decisions with wide blast radius
